title: Theory of Anomalous Diffusion and Superdiffusion in Integrable Spin Chains
abstract: Integrable systems can exhibit diffusive or Kardar--Parisi--Zhang (KPZ) scaling in two-point correlations even when their current full counting statistics (FCS) differ from those usually associated with these universality classes. We explain this separation using a multispecies particle gas that preserves the scattering structure of integrable spin chains. For anisotropy $\Delta>1$, large particles are advected by a mobile bath. The resulting FCS has a Gaussian-mixture form and approaches the M-Wright distribution at late times, with finite-time rounding due to mobile species. At the isotropic point $\Delta=1$, all particles are mobile, and the charge transfer by large particles is discrete. A self-consistent Poisson distribution describes the FCS, with a nearly Gaussian bulk and model-dependent, non-Gaussian tails. By contrast, two-point correlations follow from the statistics of a large tracer particle. For $\Delta>1$, it undergoes Brownian motion, yielding Gaussian spreading. At $\Delta=1$, we provide evidence from fluctuating hydrodynamics for the emergence of the KPZ Prähofer--Spohn scaling function in dynamical correlations and trace it to the finite coupling of the largest particles to a continuum of slower ones, with long-ranged velocity fluctuations. Our framework shows how universal dynamical two-point correlations coexist with distinct model-dependent current statistics.
summary:
1. 作者以保留XXZ链散射结构的多组分孤子气，统一描述无限温、零磁化下的两点关联与自旋流全计数统计。
2. Δ>1时高斯扩散伴随渐近趋于M-Wright律的高斯混合流统计，Δ=1时大粒子的离散输运给出具有模型依赖非高斯尾的自洽泊松分布。
3. 慢粒子间有限耦合产生的长程速度涨落解释KPZ展宽，涨落流体数值支持其两点标度函数，揭示关联普适性与非普适高阶流统计的共存。

title: Pairing from anti-Hund's coupling under infinite Hubbard repulsion
abstract: Electron-phonon coupling is a natural source of superconductivity, but in strongly correlated materials the phonon-mediated interaction is often much weaker than the on-site Hubbard repulsion $U$. Whether, and how, it can still produce pairing when $U$ dominates is a basic open question. We address this question by studying a minimal model with an anti-Hund's coupling $J_A$: an on-site spin exchange between two orbitals or two valleys, mediated by optical phonons, that favors a local inter-orbital spin singlet. In the limit $U=+\infty$, the two-orbital Hubbard model on the triangular lattice, doped away from the insulator at $n=2$ electrons per site, reduces to a four-flavor $t$-$J_A$ model. Density-matrix renormalization group calculations find robust pairing throughout $1\le J_A/|t|\le10$, with the largest pairing gap at $J_A\sim|t|$. The Cooper pairs reside on bonds and do not come from a direct attraction provided by $J_A$, since infinite $U$ excludes on-site pairs from the Hilbert space. For $J_A\gg|t|$, the normal state is a second Fermi liquid whose small Fermi surface violates the perturbative Luttinger theorem, and a strong-coupling expansion in $t/J_A$ provides a controlled effective theory of superconductivity from this unconventional metal. Our results provide strong evidence for a strongly coupled superconductor beyond BCS theory, driven by the interplay of the kinetic energy, the phonon-mediated anti-Hund's coupling, and the strong Hubbard $U$. Finally, we discuss possible applications to magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene.
summary:
1. 作者结合圆柱DMRG与强耦合展开，揭示无限Hubbard排斥下掺杂三角晶格四味模型（t<0）中声子介导反洪德交换促成键上配对的机制。
2. 在空穴掺杂x=1/4、1≤J_A/|t|≤10时，数值计算发现谷间自旋单态配对，单粒子隙最高约0.6|t|，在J_A约为|t|时最大。
3. 强耦合下，t²/J_A阶绕点跃迁克服近邻排斥产生吸引，为从小费米面第二费米液体出发的超导建立了动能辅助配对机制。

title: On the binding and stability of CeO2 molecules on low-index Au surfaces
abstract: Many multi-phase thin films grown by self-assembly involve co-deposition of both metallic and oxide phases that grow into the same film. Under such conditions, the oxide species may be present in stoichiometric molecular form on the surface of the metallic phase. Quantifying the stability, binding, and diffusion of such molecular oxide states on metallic surfaces is critical for understanding self-assembly. In this work, we investigate the binding and stability of CeO2 molecules on Au surfaces using spin-polarized density functional theory calculations. Specifically, we examine how the configuration of the CeO2 molecule, its binding energy and binding free energy, structural stability, effective charge, and projected electronic density of states vary among various binding sites on Au(001), Au(110), and Au(111) surfaces. Molecular CeO2 was found to be more favorable on all Au surfaces than its atomic constituents. It was also found that the bent CeO2 molecule configuration is more stable than the linear counterpart, with the Ce atom on the hollow site and the O atoms on the top sites. In addition, the configurations of the CeO2 molecule on Au surfaces with a binding energy around or weaker than -1 eV were found to have a low probability of existence above room temperature. Furthermore, the charge transfer was found to occur in such a way that the CeO2 molecule becomes polarized on all surfaces, but the polarization is stronger only for the strongly bonded states on Au(001) and Au(110) surfaces. Finally, three different cases of how the CeO2 molecule binds to Au(001), Au(110), and Au(111) were identified: case 1: chemisorption with symmetric bonds, case 2: chemisorption with asymmetric bonds, and case 3: physisorption with symmetric bonds. These three cases of CeO2 binding are present on Au(001) and Au(110), but only cases 2 and 3 occur on Au(111).
summary:
1. 作者利用自旋极化DFT+U与热修正，确定了CeO₂在Au(001)、(110)和(111)表面的吸附构型、分子稳定性及温度依赖的结合自由能。
2. 三种表面上分子态均比解离原子态稳定，最低能构型均呈弯曲，吸附分为Ce—O键对称或不对称的化学吸附及键对称的物理吸附，其中Au(111)仅出现后两类。
3. 热力学分析给出了约−1 eV的结合能筛选尺度，用于识别高温下占主导的吸附构型，为氧化物—金属薄膜生长中的分子迁移建模提供依据。

title: Magnetically Guided Sequential Multi-Filler Alignment Enables Anisotropic Heat Pathways in Stretchable Composites for Soft Electronics
abstract: Stretchable, skin-conformal electronics demand thermal interface materials that combine high through-plane heat transport with mechanical softness and lateral electrical insulation. In particle-filled composites, these requirements are typically antagonistic. Heat transport is governed not only by the intrinsic thermal conductivity of the fillers but, more critically, by thermal resistance at the interparticle interface. As the interparticle distance is reduced by increasing the particle content, mechanical reinforcement and in-plane electrical conductivity become unavoidable. The existing particle alignment processing strategies result in inefficient uncoupling of multifunctionality. Here, we present a hierarchical two-step process strategy to induce strong conductivity anisotropy in a soft composite. First, an align-before-blend process forms a scaffold of magnetically aligned nickel (Ni) microparticles in air before polymer infiltration. The absence of the viscous elastomer matrix during the particle alignment facilitates handling large amounts of particles, which assemble into highly ordered and densely packed vertical heat-conduction pathways. Second, a liquid metal (LM)/Ni mixture is infiltrated into the aligned scaffold to bridge interparticle gaps, minimizing interparticle thermal resistance. The composite reaches 7.5 W/(m K) through-plane thermal conductivity with lateral electrical conductivity below $10^{-12}$ S/m and ultrasoft mechanical compliance (approximately 160 kPa), enabling coupling layers in thermoelectric generators and finger-mounted heat-spreading pads for wearable technologies.
summary:
1. 为兼顾厚向导热、面内绝缘与柔顺性，作者先在空气中磁场组装镍微粒纵向骨架，再于弹性体浸渗时磁引导液态金属桥接颗粒间隙。
2. 所得复合材料厚向热导率达7.5±0.4 W/(m·K)，同时保持低于10⁻¹² S/cm的面内电导率和约160 kPa的杨氏模量，实现高效定向传热与低刚度共存。
3. 材料在25%应变下拉伸1000次后保留约94%的热导率，并提升柔性热电器件输出，验证了分离骨架构筑与接点桥接对可拉伸热界面设计的价值。

title: Spectroscopic Signatures of Polaronic Density Wave Fluctuations in Superconducting Bismuthates
abstract: The bismuthate high-temperature superconductors have been identified as potential bipolaron systems, where hole pairs are bound to local breathing distortions of the BiO$_6$ octahedra in their metallic phase. However, obtaining definitive evidence for these quasiparticles and their excitations remains challenging. Here, we report on periodic modulations of the spectral intensities and scattering rates of quasiparticles on the Fermi surfaces of doped bismuthates Ba$_{1-x}$K$_x$BiO$_3$ and BaPb$_{1-y}$Bi$_y$O$_3$, which are reminiscent of ``hot spot'' patterns that have been observed in cuprate superconductors. We show that these features can be well described by a model where electrons couple to fluctuating density wave modulations with short-range coherence along a $(\pi,\pi,\pi)$-oriented wavevector. The results are consistent with the existence of a two-component fluid where unpaired electrons interact with a fluctuating density wave created by residual bipolarons and their breathing distortions of the BiO$_6$ octahedra.
summary:
1. 为揭示母体电荷序涨落对掺杂铋酸盐金属态的影响，作者用角分辨光电子能谱在钾掺杂和铅取代铋酸钡的正常态发现费米面散射热点。
2. 谱强与散射率总体反相关，短程密度波涨落模型以分别为0.667和0.575倍(π,π,π)/a的散射波矢重现两体系的热点调制。
3. 计算所得电荷易感率肩峰支持散射与母体呼吸畸变的联系，结果与未配对电子和残余双极化子相互作用的双组分液体图像一致。

title: Extrinsic thermodynamic geometry, symmetry, and the cost of constraint
abstract: Driving a stochastic system in finite time costs excess work; exactly how much depends on which system parameters, and hence which paths in distribution space, a controller can access. In the friction-tensor formalism for slow driving, the space of equilibrium distributions is a Riemannian manifold and constraints on a controller define submanifolds. Whether a constrained controller is forced onto suboptimal paths is a question of the extrinsic thermodynamic geometry of the submanifold, which we develop for discrete systems. We show that submanifolds with zero extrinsic curvature can be identified from symmetries of the transition network, before any optimization. A minimum-work protocol on such a submanifold is therefore stationary in the excess work even when the constraints are lifted. The stationarity of symmetric optima holds exactly, beyond slow driving. In the slow-driving regime, we show that the ambient curvature transverse to a symmetric submanifold determines whether nearby symmetry-broken protocols have lower excess work. This curvature, which separates into independent contributions from each pattern of symmetry breaking, thus acquires an operational meaning as a measure of the thermodynamic incentive to break a given symmetry. A thermodynamic comparison theorem provides an inexpensive test of local minimality that weighs the extremal curvatures along the symmetric protocol against its excess work. There is no need for such tests under certain convexity conditions on the transition rates and control parameters, which guarantee that a symmetric optimum is a global optimum. These results certify the global optimality of a five-parameter protocol previously observed to match 15-parameter full control of a four-spin Ising system, and explain why partial symmetry breaking is optimal for the same system under local-field control.
summary:
1. 作者建立细致平衡马尔可夫系统的外在热力学几何，研究控制约束的耗散代价，证明动力学对称约束下的最优协议解除约束后仍为超额功驻点，且适用于任意驱动速度。
2. 慢驱动下，超额功二阶变分按对称破缺扇区解耦，横向曲率判定局部最优性；边电导为凹函数且协议空间凸时，对称最优解具有全局最优性。
3. 由此证明四自旋伊辛磁化反转的五参数对称控制达到十五参数全控制的最低耗散，说明适配动力学对称性的控制降维可不增加耗散。

title: ILMlip: fast and universal machine-learning interatomic potentials
abstract: Large-scale pretrained machine-learned interatomic potentials keep growing more accurate as new models appear at a rapid pace, and more expensive: the current leader of Matbench Discovery as of November 2026 (F1 score 0.935) has $9.9\times10^7$ parameters and took 3.6 thousand GPU-hours to train. The ILMlip potentials presented here are optimised for speed as well as zero-shot accuracy. They are equivariant, conservative message-passing potentials in which every component is arranged for throughput: little work per pair of atoms and as much as needed per atom. Through ASE on one GPU, they run molecular dynamics up to about $10^3$ times faster than state-of-the-art message-passing potentials such as MACE (medium) and up to five times faster than NEP89 and DPA-4.1C. At the same time, six sizes with $1.4\times10^5$ to $2.8\times10^7$ parameters, pretrained on materials, molecules and solid acids, reach F1 scores of 0.75 to 0.91 on Matbench Discovery, placing the largest within 0.03 of the current leader. They therefore suit high-throughput, large or long simulations, and, being transferable, they are strong starting points for fine-tuning. Fine-tuned to six materials, the model of size S comes close to the ab initio force errors of a fine-tuned MACE, so it reaches reference-level accuracy at about 50 ns per atom and step (Cu fcc). Their components can be adopted separately, as a starting point for architectures with even better ratios of speed to accuracy. The ILMlip implementation is available at this https URL
summary:
1. 为兼顾通用原子间势的精度与模拟速度，作者构建等变保守势ILMlip，将多体计算集中于原子端并仅交换一次邻域消息。
2. 六种尺寸在Matbench Discovery上的F1为0.75—0.91，S模型在单张B200上经ASE模拟万原子面心立方铜时，速度为MACE-OMAT-0中型模型的920倍。
3. S模型经六种体系微调后的平均力误差为33.5 meV/Å，接近微调MACE的30.3 meV/Å，为大规模、长时间的高精度原子模拟提供低成本途径。

title: Machine-Learning Spin-Fermion Models for Strongly Disordered Magnets: Sb-Doped MnTe
abstract: Metallic altermagnets are promising for spintronics, but most altermagnets are insulating. Doping can induce metallicity, but introduces chemical and magnetic disorder that is challenging to model from first principles. Here, we introduce a machine-learning approach that renormalizes first-principles calculations onto disordered spin-fermion models. The learned models accurately reproduce first-principles magnetic and electronic properties and enable predictions of millions of inequivalent long-range exchange couplings in large disordered supercells. Applied to Sb-doped MnTe, the approach shows that altermagnetism persists up to about 25\% Sb, and reveals disorder broadening as a new factor controlling spin selectivity. More broadly, our work opens a route to combining renormalization with machine-learned Hamiltonians for strongly disordered materials.
summary:
1. 作者将第一性原理计算映射为机器学习自旋—费米子模型，求得Sb掺杂MnTe大超胞的非共线磁基态与电子谱，追踪无序中的交错磁性演化。
2. 模型预测约600万个不等价交换耦合，显示交错磁性保持至约25%掺杂，向铁磁性演化的交叉区出现非共线基态。
3. 无序展宽造成相反自旋谱权重重叠并降低自旋选择性，表明掺杂交错磁体的设计需同时考虑自旋劈裂与无序散射。

title: Graphical Rules for Zero-energy Quantum-Interference Patterns in Bipartite Lattices
abstract: Quantum interference(QI) plays an important role in electron transport in molecules, where conductance is determined by the coherent superposition of different quantum-walk paths connecting the source and drain sites. In some systems, the pronounced even-odd conductance oscillation with the walk length can be observed; meanwhile destructive QI can lead to a dramatic suppression of conductance, resulting in a huge on/off ratio. In this paper, we extend the investigation from individual molecules to bipartite lattice systems, providing an abstract framework for exploring QI in a broad range of two-dimensional systems. We propose a simple graphical rule for predicting the QI pattern-the conductance map obtained by varying the drain site while keeping the source site fixed-in bipartite structures with arbitrary boundaries and holes. The analysis can be completed in three steps. First, a unit-cell-replicated bipartite subset is constructed by removing a subset of atoms from the input network, and its Green's function map is efficiently obtained from a local recurrence relation. Second, the removed atoms and local structural modifications are coupled back as local degrees of freedom, generating zero-mode vectors through the same Green's function map. Finally, the surviving zero-mode combinations are selected by an effective coupling matrix, whose projectors correct the reference map to yield the final QI pattern. This rule applies to finite flakes with arbitrary boundaries and holes and extends naturally to infinite lattices and vacancy defects.
summary:
1. 作者在手征对称二分晶格中建立固定源点零能透射图的图形构造法，处理任意边界及孔洞的有限薄片与单格点源漏接触。
2. 蜂窝参考薄片未截断定向扇区内的格林函数振幅服从杨辉三角，局域有效矩阵确定零模，源漏的零模投影非零且共线时同子晶格通道开放。
3. 该框架以有限秩修正处理无限石墨烯中的局域缺陷，为依据零模位置及子晶格归属筛选输运结构提供了途径。

title: Solvent-Mediated Disintegration of a Vitrimer Network
abstract: Vitrimers are dynamic polymer networks characterized by associative bond exchange, which enables topological rearrangement while preserving the overall network connectivity. However, how this dynamic connectivity evolves in the presence of a solvent, particularly as a function of temperature, remains poorly understood. Here, we employ hybrid molecular dynamics Monte Carlo simulations to elucidate the temperature-dependent restructuring and dissociation of vitrimer networks in solution. By constructing temperature composition phase diagrams, we demonstrate that the critical temperature for network dissolution increases nonlinearly with crosslink concentration. We find that the network disintegration begins well below the critical dissolution temperature, indicating that the loss of network connectivity can occur even before the onset of macroscopic dissolution. However, the network undergoes extensive restructuring around the critical temperature for a highly crosslinked system, resulting in the formation of numerous smaller, disconnected networks. Concurrently, the number of intrachain dynamic bonds increases with temperature. Interestingly, complete disintegration into individual polymer chains is not observed; instead, the solution comprises a broad distribution of smaller network fragments. These findings reveal the complex interplay between solvent-induced network disintegration and dynamic bond redistribution, providing molecular level insights into the dissolution of vitrimer networks and their potential for solvent assisted recycling.
summary:
1. 作者用显式溶剂中的分子动力学—蒙特卡洛模拟，构建类玻璃聚合物溶液相图并揭示网络随温度升高的解体过程。
2. 临界溶解温度随交联浓度非线性升高，网络解体在远低于该温度时已开始，高交联体系在临界温度附近显著碎裂。
3. 链间交联向链内环的转移揭示了总交联数不变时连通性丧失的机制，溶解后仍保留尺寸分布宽广的网络碎片，表明宏观溶解与网络完全解体是不同过程。

title: Exact subtraction of electron self-interaction from the Kohn-Sham equations
abstract: The self-interaction error (SIE) of Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT) leads to a non-physical, non-linear dependence of an orbital's energy on its own fractional occupation [Dabo et al., Phys. Rev. B, 82:115121, 2010]. The generalized Koopmans condition (GKC) ensures an atomic orbital's eigenenergy is independent of its fractional occupation$-$ and is free of self-interaction. The constrained search of the Levy spin-density-functional theory yields orbital densities and delivers the ground-state energy to generalize the Hohenberg-Kohn theorems. In this work, the electron density of the Kohn-Sham equations is constrained to be orbital-density dependent, with a total energy functional linear with respect to variation of its orbital densities. That is, the KS multiplicative effective potential $v_{\text{s}}[{n}]$ for an orbital $\varphi_i[{n}]$ is constrained to a functional $v_{\text{eff}}[{n - n_i}]$. The result complies with the generalized Koopmans condition (GKC). This approach improves LDA and GGA mean absolute errors (MAEs) in fundamental band gaps by $\sim$ 1 eV, with respect to KS-DFT. Equations free of electron self-interaction provide the basis for improvements in the accuracy, efficiency, and simplicity of density functional theories.
summary:
1. 针对Kohn–Sham理论中的电子自相互作用，作者构建并实现量子线性密度泛函方程，将各轨道有效势的密度依赖限定为其余电子的密度。
2. 六种晶体的非自旋极化计算表明，采用局域密度近似时，基本带隙相对零点重整化修正实验值的平均绝对误差由1.36降至0.45 eV。
3. 该构造使轨道本征能独立于自身分数占据、总能量满足广义分段线性条件，将自相互作用消除直接纳入自洽方程。

title: Superconductivity from a Cooper surface instability in a nodal Bose metal
abstract: In underdoped cuprates, the superconducting gap is largest where low-energy electron spectral weight is already depleted above the transition. How can a weak attraction drive superconductivity when the one-electron density of states vanishes? In a momentum-space \(t\)--\(J\) model, the exactly solvable normal state is a nodal Bose metal with four one-electron nodes. Along two contours called Cooper surfaces, adding or removing a spin-singlet pair of electrons with opposite momenta costs no energy. The resulting logarithmic divergence of the pair susceptibility allows an arbitrarily weak pair-transfer attraction to stabilize a correlated nodal \(d\)-wave superconductor. Spin-resolved coincidence photoemission could test this pairing mechanism by resolving two zero-energy pair-removal ridges above the transition and a third along the underlying Luttinger surface below it.
summary:
1. 针对单电子态密度消失时弱吸引如何驱动超导，作者在正常态可精确求解的动量空间t–J模型中揭示了节点玻色金属的库珀面失稳机制。
2. 两条库珀面上添加或移除动量相反的自旋单态电子对无需能量，导致配对易感率对数发散，使任意弱的对转移吸引稳定关联节点d波超导。
3. 自旋分辨符合光电子发射可检验该机制：转变温度以上存在两条零能电子对移除谱脊，以下沿底层卢廷格面新增第三条。

title: Controlling truncation errors in loop tensor network renormalization
abstract: At finite bond dimension $\chi$, tensor network renormalization (TNR) of a critical model eventually becomes gapped. For LoopTNR with $O(2)$ symmetry on the $c=1$ critical line of the six-vertex model, parametrized by the Luttinger parameter $K$, we show that the correlation length $\xi$ of the gapped phase is set by the seed of the dimerization injected by the truncation, and depends on $\chi$ only through it. Read from a weak-coupling window early in the same run, the seed predicts $\xi=10^3$-$10^{16}$ via the sine-Gordon mass-coupling relation with no free parameter, to within a few percent for $K\le1.5$ and about 10% at $K=1.75$; since the seed fluctuates strongly with $\chi$, $\xi$ is not monotonic in $\chi$. An alternation of the vertex weights shifts the seed; with its sign read from a $\pi$ twist, one short calibration predicts a counterterm that delays the breakdown in 16 of the 17 compensated groups of a campaign fixed in advance. A correction of the coarse-grained tensors, repeated during the flow, keeps the runs at $K=1$ and $1.5$ critical up to step 160, the last step computed, and exposes the marginal truncation error that remains. Our findings illustrate a systematic procedure for controlling the relevant truncation error, and thereby extending the critical window, in tensor network renormalization at finite bond dimension.
summary:
1. 作者确定六顶点模型K<2临界区间的O(2)对称LoopTNR中，截断注入的二聚化种子决定有限键维的开隙尺度，并解释关联长度随键维的非单调变化。
2. 弱耦合谱提取的种子通过正弦–戈登质量—耦合关系，无自由参数预测10³至10¹⁶个晶格间距的关联长度，K≤1.5时精度达几个百分点。
3. 固定键维下，π扭转读出引导的重复补偿使K=1和1.5的流保持临界至已计算的第160步，并显露沿临界线的残余边缘漂移。

title: Phono3GPU: GPU-Accelerated Linear Tetrahedron Integration for Phonon Thermal Transport
abstract: Materials with high or low thermal conductivity are increasingly important for thermal management and energy technologies. Machine-learned interatomic potentials have accelerated anharmonic force-constant calculations, shifting the bottleneck toward phonon transport calculations for large materials datasets. Existing GPU solvers often rely on smearing, whose width can require material-dependent choices, while the linear tetrahedron method used in phono3py avoids this parameter but becomes costly for complex structures. Here we introduce Phono3GPU, which reformulates three-phonon scattering and linear tetrahedron integration for massively parallel GPU execution. Across benchmark crystals, Phono3GPU accelerates total calculations by up to 41 times relative to a CPU implementation, with larger gains for complex unit cells, and by 2 to 6 times relative to a recent GPU plug-in for phono3py. We further demonstrate atom-resolved scattering analysis in defective silicon supercells as an application enabled by the reduced computational cost. Phono3GPU thus lowers the cost of tetrahedron-based thermal-conductivity calculations and of detailed investigations of structure-dependent phonon transport.
summary:
1. 针对复杂晶体热输运的计算瓶颈，作者开发Phono3GPU，将无需展宽参数的线性四面体积分与三声子散射计算并行化，并实现保留原子间干涉的线宽分解。
2. 基准热导率与phono3py高度一致，单GPU相对32线程CPU的总耗时加速比最高达41，并完成了312原子界面的散射通道分析。

title: Exploring Physical Mechanisms Underlying the Emergence of Collective Order
abstract: Emergence of collective order from disordered constituents is a hallmark of active matter, and the Vicsek model (VM) serves as a paradigmatic system for its study. However, whether density-induced emergence in the VM differs between angular (intrinsic) and vectorial (extrinsic) noise, and what mechanisms govern the transitions, remain largely unexplored. Remarkably, we uncover that collective order emerges from a disordered state in a continuous-like manner under intrinsic noise but abruptly under extrinsic noise. Combining nonequilibrium landscape-flux theory with a coarse-grained mapping method, we show that the landscape evolves continuously from a single basin to two and back to one under intrinsic noise, but the two-basin landscape appears abruptly under extrinsic noise across the critical transition to flocking. The counterclockwise nonequilibrium flux sustains global circular motion, providing the driving force for reshaping the landscape. The mean flux and entropy production rate change steeply near the emergence threshold and exhibit pronounced peaks within the coexistence region, identifying them as the dynamical and thermodynamic origins of emergence. Our findings reveal a distinct abrupt emergence under extrinsic noise and offer deeper mechanistic insight, practical applications (e.g., locating phase boundaries and distinguishing transition types), and extensibility to other nonequilibrium collective systems.
summary:
1. 作者将Vicsek模型映射至局域密度—有序度空间，结合景观—通量分析，数值揭示内外禀噪声下密度诱导集体有序的不同机制。
2. 内禀角噪声下，无序单阱经共存双阱平滑演化为有序单阱，对应类连续转变；外禀矢量噪声下有序度突跃、共存双阱骤现。
3. 非平衡环流驱动共存局域态间切换，平均通量和熵产生率在阈值附近陡变并在带相内达峰，为定位相界和区分转变类型提供动力学与热力学指标。

title: Rotation curves of dwarf galaxies and dark matter as a condensate of $q$-deformed bosons: reconstruction and fits of the deformation profile
abstract: Dark-matter-dominated dwarf galaxies are a sensitive testing ground for models in which dark matter is a self-interacting Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC). In the Thomas-Fermi limit the standard BEC halo has the density profile $\rho\propto\sin(kr)/(kr)$, so that the shape of its rotation curve is fixed up to two scale parameters. Here we consider a condensate of $q$-deformed bosons. We show that, in the Thomas-Fermi limit, the deformation enters the structure of the halo only through the chemical potential of the condensate; consequently, a spatially uniform deformation parameter leaves the standard BEC profile unchanged. In every galaxy $\chi$ is depressed in the inner region, $kr\lesssim1$, relative to the outer halo, where it is approximately constant in most cases: the standard condensate describes the outer halo, while the core requires a weaker deformation, i.e., $q$ closer to unity. The profiles share this qualitative shape, but neither the depth nor the width of the depression is universal. Modelling the depression by a Gaussian, with two additional parameters, we fit the rotation curves with rms residuals of $0.6$--$2.6$~km\,s$^{-1}$, against $1.6$--$8.5$~km\,s$^{-1}$ for the standard condensate. According to the Bayesian information criterion, the deformed condensate is preferred over the standard condensate, the Navarro-Frenk-White profile, and the Burkert profile in four galaxies, is indistinguishable from the best of them in two, and is disfavoured in two. We discuss the limitations of these results, in particular the absence of error bars in the data, the neglect of baryons, and the phenomenological status of a position-dependent deformation.
summary:
1. 针对矮星系旋转曲线，作者证明托马斯–费米极限下均匀q形变保持标准凝聚晕轮廓，并建立局域唯象形变的解析反演。
2. 在忽略重子的无权拟合中，新增两个高斯凹陷参数的模型相较标准凝聚晕、NFW及Burkert模型，按贝叶斯信息准则在八个星系中四例获优选、两例持平、两例处于劣势。
3. 反演为旋转曲线偏离标准凝聚晕提供了逐点诊断，揭示八个星系共同的核心形变减弱趋势，以及凹陷深度和宽度的非普适性。

title: Wannier-Based Low-Energy Electronic Structure Analysis of $λ$-(STF)$_2$GaCl$_4$
abstract: The low-energy electronic structures of $\lambda$-(BETS)$_2$GaCl$_4$ and $\lambda$-(STF)$_2$GaCl$_4$ were investigated using density functional theory (DFT) and maximally localized Wannier functions (MLWFs). For $\lambda$-(STF)$_2$GaCl$_4$, DFT-selected and directly XRD-refined structural models were compared before and after fixed-lattice relaxation. Their initially different near-Fermi-level electronic structures become similar after relaxation. Relative to BETS, relaxed STF has a narrower frontier bandwidth while retaining a substantial dimerization energy scale. Two MLWFs were constructed for each selected unrelaxed structure to represent the upper frontier bands, with total spreads of 36.708 Å$^2$ for BETS and 37.578 Å$^2$ for STF. The Wannier-derived transfer integrals show a pronounced reduction of $t_{d1}$ from 51 meV in BETS to 6.5 meV in STF, indicating selective modification of the low-energy electronic connectivity.
summary:
1. 作者用密度泛函和最大局域化Wannier函数比较λ-(BETS)₂GaCl₄与λ-(STF)₂GaCl₄，考察分子替换及结构模型对低能电子结构的影响。
2. 固定晶格弛豫使两种STF模型的近费米能电子结构趋同，STF带宽较BETS窄且保留显著二聚化能标；所选未弛豫结构中，跃迁参数t_d1由BETS的51降至STF的6.5 meV。
3. 结合其他数条二聚体间跃迁保持相近的结果，该分析表明分子替换选择性改变了低能电子连通性，为二聚体低能模型提供了微观参数。

title: Frustration in system with intercalated and bilayer smectic structure
abstract: The dimeric mesogens exhibit an unusual variety of mesophases - nematic and smectic, with distinctly different packing schemes. The relation between molecular and mesophase structure was studied for homologue series of non-symmetric bent dimers this http URL , obtained by serial Pd- and Pt-catalyzed cross-coupling chemical reactions. The shorter homologues of the series form smectics with an intercalated structure, and longer homologues form bilayer smectics with broken up-down symmetry of molecular orientation within the layers, for intermediate homologues frustration leads to a nematic gap. The additional structure complexity arises from the tendency of bent dimers to form twisted structures, in which the azimuthal angle of tilted molecules forms both short- and long-pitch helices. Here we confirm, through resonant X-ray diffraction, that longer homologues form a helical four-layer structure of SmCTB-SH phase, along with a more complex one in which, in addition to the basic four-layer unit, an extra helix is superimposed, SmCTB-DH phase. This additional helix has a periodicity that is strongly temperature-dependent; upon cooling, it changes from 100 nm to 40 nm.
summary:
1. 作者研究非对称弯曲二聚体CBO6.Om的链长依赖相行为，确定其近晶堆积随末端链增长由插层转为双层结构。
2. 共振X射线散射证实，m=9的四层螺旋近晶相在降温后叠加长周期螺旋，后者螺距在约4 K降温区间内由100 nm缩至40 nm。
3. 两种堆积倾向的竞争导致中间同系物出现向列相间隙，混溶实验中两类近晶相不互溶且接触区形成向列相的结果支持了这一受挫机制。

title: Quantum Geometric Origin of Néel-Order-Driven Magneto-Optical Response in MnTe
abstract: Magneto-optical (MO) responses provide a direct probe of magnetic order, yet resolving compensated antiferromagnetic order remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate in altermagnetic MnTe that the symmetry of the Néel order is imprinted on the MO response through distinct quantum-geometric contributions. Combining first-principles calculations with a Landau symmetry framework, we demonstrate that the quantum metric gives rise to a twofold optical anisotropy, with its diagonal and symmetric off-diagonal components forming an $E_{2g}$ doublet associated with the quadratic Néel-order invariants, providing a characteristic MO Voigt signature of the Néel-vector orientation. In contrast, the Berry curvature generates a complementary threefold Hall response governed by the cubic $A_{2g}$ Néel-order invariant. Although the Hall conductivity and the out-of-plane weak-ferromagnetic moment share the same symmetry and angular dependence, constraining the latter to zero leaves the optical Hall response essentially unchanged demonstrating that the Hall response originates directly from the compensated Néel order rather than the net magnetization. Our results establish quantum geometry as a direct link between Néel order and MO response, revealing distinct twofold and threefold optical signatures of Néel order in altermagnetic MnTe.
summary:
1. 作者结合第一性原理计算与朗道对称性分析，揭示交错磁体MnTe中面内奈尔序通过量子几何控制磁光响应的机制。
2. 量子度规通过二次E₂g奈尔序组合产生二重沃伊特各向异性，贝里曲率通过三次A₂g不变量产生三重光学霍尔响应。
3. 将面外净磁矩约束为零后，霍尔响应基本不变，确立了其补偿奈尔序起源，而两个磁光通道为辨识奈尔矢量取向提供互补探针。

title: Quantum Metric Connects Bond Delocalization to Phonon Softening
abstract: Delocalized bonding electrons have long been associated with soft bonds and low phonon frequencies. However, a quantitative connection between electron delocalization and phonon softening remains elusive. We identify such a connection through the momentum-space quantum metric, which measures the intrinsic delocalization of the occupied electronic states. We show that a quantum geometric contribution to phonon softening is proportional to the integrated quantum metric. First-principles calculations of more than a hundred compounds demonstrate that greater quantum metric generally accompanies softer phonons. Localized Wannier orbitals reveal the bonding environments associated with this delocalization. In ferroelectric GeTe, LiBeSb, and BaTiO$_3$, polar distortion localizes the bonding orbitals, reduces quantum metric, and stabilizes the soft mode of the nonpolar structure. In PbSe, pressure-induced band inversion is accompanied by an enhanced quantum metric and phonon softening without change in crystal symmetry and bonding. These results establish a common quantum geometric interpretation of bond delocalization and phonon softening across distinct bonding environments.
summary:
1. 作者在有效耦合近似下，推导出占据态积分量子度量与力常数几何贡献的比例关系，定量连接成键电子离域与声子软化。
2. 逾百种结构的第一性原理计算显示，在相同标称电荷与配位组内，度量增益越大，经质量标度的横光学声子频率通常越低。
3. GeTe等三种铁电体的极性畸变使轨道局域化并稳定软模，PbSe能带反转伴随相对压缩趋势的声子软化，为结构与拓扑转变中的晶格柔化提供共同的量子几何解释。

title: Length-scales and fractal scaling in dairy gels: comparisons of the insights from ultra-small angle neutron scattering and rheology
abstract: A key structural parameter that dictates the textural properties of a particulate gel is the fractal dimension (Df) of the network indicating self-similarity within the spatial range defined by the correlation length (xi). In this study dairy gels are formed from reconstituted skim milk at defined CM volume fractions via two different mechanisms: acidification, and enzymatic (rennet)-induction. Oscillatory rheology is performed to obtain the gelation times, the time-scale for the maturation of mechanical properties of the gel, and the viscoelastic properties of the gel. A direct probe of gel structure is ultra-small-angle neutron scattering (USANS) examining length-scales from approximately 60 nm up to 15 microns. Structural information is extracted from USANS of matured gels by comparing the measured differential scattering cross-section with that calculated from a model constrained by the sample composition. Time-scales for structural equilibration from USANS perspective were shorter than the rheological gelation time for both gels. Rheological scaling theories are utilized to relate the microstructure to their bulk mechanical properties. We show that the fractal scaling at low-q (scattering vectors), due to aggregation of CM, extracted from the USANS at the longest timescales is described by a power-law density-density correlation function, and that rheology relates - through Shih-Wu-Morbidelli models - the local elasticity both within and between the fractal flocs formed by these particles over different size ranges to the bulk moduli of the gels. There are similar values of fractal dimensions from both techniques but different sizes attributed to the complex fractal evolution during dairy gelation, which leaves space to refinements of the models.
summary:
1. 作者结合超小角中子散射与振荡流变，比较酸凝和酶凝复原脱脂乳凝胶的分形结构，考察密度关联与宏观弹性的联系。
2. 两种方法给出约2.4—2.5的相近分形维数，成熟凝胶的散射相关长度约1微米，流变标度模型推得的弹性絮团尺度更大。
3. 标度分析将宏观刚度联系到絮团内外的共同弹性贡献，密度关联与弹性尺度的差异提示成熟乳凝胶具有层级分形组织。

title: Quantum-centric assessment of saturated ferromagnetism beyond the flat-band limit
abstract: Saturated ferromagnetism has been proven for every on-site repulsion $U > 0$ in Hubbard models with a flat lowest band, and the interaction required for it grows with the band width $W$ when the band becomes dispersive. We study the dispersive case at quarter filling by quantum-selected configuration interaction and sample-based quantum diagonalization with IBM Quantum's Heron processors, focusing on the quantized square of the total spin of the computed states. We treat a sawtooth chain of 16 unit cells on 64 qubits, whose full configuration space of $1.1\times 10^{14}$ determinants exceeds that of one of the largest full configuration interaction calculations, and obtain the stability diagram of saturated ferromagnetism on the decorated square lattice in the plane of $U$ and $W$. For the chain, a subspace of only $3\times 10^{-5}$ of the full configuration space gives a state with more than $97\%$ of its weight in the sector of maximal spin. For the decorated square lattice of $4\times 3$ unit cells on 48 qubits, the computed states in subspaces of less than $1\%$ of the full configuration space switch from low-spin states to nearly fully polarized states at $U \simeq 2W$. The calculations also give a rigorous lower bound of $1.9W$ on the critical interaction of the $4\times 3$ lattice.
summary:
1. 作者通过量子采样子空间对角化与总自旋平方诊断，研究四分之一填充Hubbard模型中锯齿链和装饰正方晶格偏离平带后的饱和铁磁稳定性。
2. 铁磁占据初始化下，4×3晶格不足1%组态空间中的计算态在U≈2W由低自旋转为最大自旋权重超过99.3%的态，变分能量另给出严格下界Uc>1.9W，其中W为带宽。
3. 这一计算态转变与4×2晶格精确对角化所得临界值接近，提示装饰正方晶格在热力学极限下的临界比值Uc/W也接近2。

title: Patterns and correlations in time-reversal symmetry breaking
abstract: Time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking is the hallmark of non-equilibrium statistical physics. This notwithstanding, in translationally invariant systems, it is almost always treated only as a global quantity. We propose to use the local entropy production rate as a spatio-temporal field to describe extended homogeneous non-equilibrium systems. We find that this field generically displays spatial correlations, with a typical length that grows as we approach some non-equilibrium phase transitions. We also show that the correlation length associated with the local entropy production rate follows heretofore unknown scaling laws involving control parameters as well as the observation time used for trajectories. Our work paves the way to the use of the local entropy production as a powerful observable to identify the scale and source of TRS breaking in non-equilibrium systems.
summary:
1. 作者以有限时间局域熵产生率为时空场，数值揭示均匀活性流体与吸收态模型活跃相中时间反演对称性破缺的空间关联。
2. 守恒格气的关联长度随观测时间增长，随临界密度差增大按幂律衰减，指数从近临界约0.8交叉至远离临界约0.22。
3. 近临界格气中熵产生与时间积分活度的紧密对应，将局域不可逆性联系到活性位点运动，并支持临界关联与传播尺度竞争的解释。

title: Fractional Chern Insulator in a Finite-Range One-Band Model
abstract: A common route for realizing fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) is to engineer bands that mimic the physics of Landau levels, which serve as the single-particle topological background for the emergence of strongly correlated fractional quantum Hall states. Here we show that FCIs can also arise in a one-band model devoid of any single-particle quantum geometry. Through a systematic trivialization of the single-particle quantum geometry in FCI models that go beyond the Landau-level paradigm, we construct a single-band, interaction-only model on the square lattice, with all terms confined to individual plaquettes. At one-third filling, exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization-group calculations reveal a three-state low-energy manifold, a Hall conductance of $-2e^2/(3h)$, and fractional charge pumping without translation-symmetry breaking. We trace this behavior to nontrivial topology in the repulsive two-particle sector, offering a microscopic perspective on the strongly correlated origin of fractional quantum Hall order.
summary:
1. 作者构造了无单粒子跃迁、仅含单方格内相互作用的正方晶格单轨道费米子模型，确立了单粒子量子几何缺失时的分数陈绝缘体。
2. 精确对角化与密度矩阵重整化群显示，三分之一填充下出现保持平移对称性的三态低能流形，霍尔电导为−2e²/(3h)，每磁通量子泵送约2e/3电荷。
3. 两个强排斥双粒子通道的总陈数为+1，显示相互作用可承载非平庸拓扑，为超越单粒子能带几何的分数霍尔态设计提供微观线索。

title: Anisotropic magnetic-field modulation of hysteretic sheet resistance in few-layer ferroelectric WTe2
abstract: Ferroelectricity in few-layer WTe2, a polar semimetal, originates from interlayer sliding and can be probed through gate-dependent resistance hysteresis. Yet the role of magnetic fields in this transport signature remains largely unexplored. Here, we examine magnetic-field-induced changes in the hysteresis in exfoliated few-layer WTe2. Applying an out-of-plane magnetic field produces a pronounced hysteresis enhancement, while an in-plane field yields a negligible response. Analysis of the individual hysteresis branches reveals distinct magnetotransport responses of the two ferroelectric states, which increase their resistance separation under magnetic field. The enhancement exhibits a robust power-law field dependence and a temperature evolution closely resembling that of magnetoresistance. Our results reveal a close association between anisotropic magnetotransport and ferroelectric hysteresis, underscoring the interplay between magnetic response and ferroic order in a two-dimensional polar semimetal.
summary:
1. 针对磁场如何调制少层WTe₂的铁电电阻滞回，作者通过分支分辨输运测量发现，面外场使高阻分支的电阻增量更大，从而扩大两态反差。
2. 2 K下，四个器件的滞回面积增量均随面外场呈幂律增长，拟合指数为0.94—2.67，三个受测器件对面内沿电流磁场的响应可忽略。
3. 滞回增强随升温减弱、近室温可忽略，其温度演化与磁阻相近，确立了各向异性磁输运与铁电态电阻反差调控的联系。

title: Intrinsically nonlinear nanomechanical resonator toward the single-phonon Kerr regime
abstract: Manipulating a physical system at the single-quantum level typically requires an anharmonic energy spectrum. Nanomechanical resonators, however, are commonly admitted to be linear objects in the single-phonon regime, thus motivating most efforts to employ external sources of nonlinearity at the cost of added relaxation and decoherence channels. Here, we take a radically different approach by directly exploiting strong intrinsic mechanical nonlinearities. We quantify this nonlinearity using a novel method based on the coupling between bending modes. Using this technique, we establish an upper bound of 34.0 +/- 9.7 phonons for the onset of intrinsically mechanical bistability. In addition, we highlight a new tuning mechanism based on a mechanical polarization angle of an upward-buckled nanotube resonator allowing us to reach an optimal working point. Extrapolating this level of intrinsic nonlinearity to realistically shorter resonators shows that the single-phonon Kerr regime is within reach, allowing for the realization of purely mechanical Schrödinger-cat states and highly coherent mechanical qubits.
summary:
1. 作者在上拱碳纳米管中利用双音谱探测弯曲模间耦合，分离电子隧穿贡献并定量提取本征杜芬非线性。
2. 栅控偏振旋转使非线性最大值与频率最小值重合，估得双稳态起始振幅与零点振幅之比的上界为34.0±9.7。
3. 结合已报道低损耗率的尺寸外推表明，缩短纳米管可进入纯机械单声子克尔区间，为机械量子比特与猫态提供实现路径。

title: Electronic topological modes in hexagonal NbSi$_{2}$ with a double helix
abstract: Chiral systems can host nontrivial topological states, including characteristic edge modes and Fermi arcs. Here, we investigate the electronic properties of hexagonal NbSi$_2$ with chiral symmetry using first-principles calculations for both bulk and slab geometries. We find that spin--orbit coupling (SOC) is relatively weak. Notably, the topological edge state originates from structural chirality rather than the SOC. From the Berry curvature analysis, we confirm the existence of Weyl points, some of which carry a Chern number of $\pm 2$. Furthermore, we demonstrate the existence of chiral edge modes with extended Fermi arcs around high-symmetry points. Finally, we investigate the real-space localization using spatially resolved and site-dependent density of states (DOS). We demonstrate that the surface states can be exclusively associated with the chiral Si chains.
summary:
1. 作者通过体相与薄层第一性原理计算，揭示了含硅双螺旋的六方NbSi₂中非对称型手性结构所支撑的电子拓扑态。
2. 计算确认了陈数为±2的外尔节点及(001)表面的延展费米弧，手性表面态在无自旋轨道耦合时仍然存在。
3. 费米能附近的表面态电荷主要局域于表层硅原子，揭示了硅链与表面局域的联系，并为高分辨扫描隧道显微镜探测提供了研究对象。

title: Spin-Orbit Coupling in Symmetry-Forbidden Reactions: A Selection Rule Tested on the Chalcogen Trimers
abstract: A reaction is forbidden by orbital symmetry when an occupied and an empty orbital of different symmetry change places along its path. With spin-orbit coupling orbitals become spinors, and those of two such orbitals can mix only if the orbitals differ by the symmetry of a rotation; the operator component of that symmetry couples ground state and diradical triplet. We test this rule on the ring opening of the chalcogen trimers O3 to Po3, where an in-plane and an out-of-plane orbital cross ($C_{2v}$ surfaces; NEVPT2, spin-orbit configuration interaction), by letting the operator components act separately. In Se3 and Te3 the component named by the rule alone lowers the barrier by 2.2 and 5.1 kcal/mol (complete operator: 2.2 and 5.2), the other two by 0.2 and 1.3 kcal/mol; in Po3 they contribute in second order. The triplet crosses the ground state 6.5 to 9.0 kcal/mol below the forbidden saddle. Spin-orbit coupling makes this crossing passable in O3 and S3 and, from Se3 on, merges the two states into one surface whose saddle lies 2.6, 5.5, and 13.1 kcal/mol lower. Molecular rotation obeys the same rule but is 6 to $2.8\times 10^{3}$ times weaker, which bears on the lifetime predicted for cyclic ozone.
summary:
1. 作者推导并以O₃至Po₃开环计算验证：沿保对称路径，交叉轨道直积含旋转表示，是对称性允许基态与双自由基三重态间自旋—轨道耦合的充要条件。
2. Se₃、Te₃中，指定轴向分量给出的势垒与完整算符相差小于0.2千卡/摩尔，Po₃中其余分量经二阶混合显著贡献。
3. 这一通道使O₃、S₃经非绝热跃迁绕过禁阻鞍点，并使Se₃至Po₃形成具有更低鞍点的单一势能面，揭示禁阻开环随耦合增强的机制转变。

title: A Thermodynamically Consistent Model of a Rechargeable Salt-in-Polyelectrolyte Battery
abstract: We present an isothermal, thermodynamically consistent model of a salt-in-polyelectrolyte battery with intercalation and deintercalation reactions of cations occurring at the electrode-electrolyte interfaces under galvanostatic conditions. For the electrolyte, we consider polyelectrolytes, which are polyanions, with neutralizing cations (i.e., counterions) such as lithium, along with a monovalent salt containing the same cations. Models of batteries containing either a dual-ion-conductor (DIC) electrolyte (i.e., uncharged polymers with added salt) or a single-ion-conductor (SIC) electrolyte (i.e., charged polymers without added salt) emerge as limiting cases of this thermodynamically consistent model. Once the model is presented in its most general context, we make specific choices so that it captures well-known mechanisms. In particular, the governing diffusion equations recover Fick's law of diffusion, and the cation-transfer reaction rate is described by the Butler--Volmer equation. The DIC and SIC limiting cases provide a framework for comparing the corresponding batteries. One-dimensional DIC and SIC charge--discharge simulations at matched current and duration illustrate concentration redistribution, polarization, and electrode utilization. Numerical accuracy checks quantify sensitivity to discretization; distinct initial inventories qualify the comparison.

title: Exact Lyapunov spectrum and localization length of the multichannel disordered Schrödinger equation
abstract: We consider the multichannel Schrödinger equation, describing the evolution of $N$ transverse modes in a finite width wire, in the presence of a Gaussian white noise potential in the unitary symmetry class. For arbitrary energy $E$ and disorder strength $T$, we compute exactly the set of Lyapunov exponents $\{ \gamma_n(E,T) \}_{1 \leq n \leq N}$ which define the decay rates of the wave functions. In the large energy regime, we recover that the Lyapunov exponents are equally spaced, as predicted by the so-called DMPK approach. However we show that this property breaks down at arbitrary energy, giving rise to a richer Lyapunov spectrum. We also uncover a direct relation between the localization length, given by the inverse of the smallest Lyapunov exponent, and the density of states. Our derivation relies on the analysis of matrix stochastic differential equation for a modified Riccati matrix.
summary:
1. 作者利用修正里卡蒂矩阵的随机动力学，精确求得幺正对称类高斯白噪声矩阵势导线在任意通道数、能量及无序强度下的全部李雅普诺夫指数。
2. 所得谱在一般能量下不等间距，在大正、负能量极限渐近等间距，其中正能量结果恢复DMPK预测。
3. 局域化长度的倒数等于积分态密度对能量的对数导数乘以噪声强度的一半，建立了由态密度直接确定局域化长度的精确途径。

title: Seebeck and Hall effects in charge-neutral ballistic graphene as probes of electron-electron interactions
abstract: Electron-hole asymmetry of the Coulomb velocity renormalization is responsible for finite Seebeck and Hall coefficients in charge-neutral graphene. In the ballistic regime the thermopower is small, $0.1$--$1~\mu$V/K, because the chemical-potential shift required by $n_e{=}n_h$ cancels its leading part. When the electron-electron scattering length falls below the sample length, the thermopower crosses over to a collision-dominated value of $4$--$10~\mu$V/K, that is an order of magnitude larger. This crossover is a direct thermoelectric marker of the breakdown of ballistic transport and a baseline for identifying the Dirac fluid.
summary:
1. 作者理论揭示，电中性石墨烯中电子—空穴不对称的库仑速度重整化产生非零塞贝克系数和弱场霍尔系数。

3. 这一从弹道到碰撞主导输运的跨越提供了弹道输运失效的热电标志，并为识别狄拉克流体建立基准。

title: LetzElPhC: an electron-phonon code for efficient exciton-phonon workflows
abstract: We present \texttt{LetzElPhC}, an open-source software package that computes electron-phonon matrix elements from the output of density functional perturbation theory calculations performed with the \texttt{Quantum ESPRESSO} code. By interfacing directly with the \texttt{Yambo} code and exploiting crystal symmetries, \texttt{LetzElPhC} enables a scalable workflow for evaluating exciton-phonon matrix elements while enforcing strict gauge consistency between one-electron Bloch states and Bethe-Salpeter excitonic wave functions across the full Brillouin zone. This symmetry-preserving approach avoids phase ambiguities and significantly reduces both computational costs and memory requirements. To support large-scale simulations on dense momentum grids, the package incorporates Fourier interpolation of dynamical matrices and perturbed Kohn-Sham potentials, accounting for long-range dipole and quadrupole interactions in both two- and three-dimensional materials, combined with multi-level parallelization and efficient parallel I/O. Together, these capabilities seamlessly complement the \texttt{Yambo} code to enable first-principles simulations of phonon-assisted optical spectroscopies, which we demonstrate through applications to resonant Raman scattering in monolayer $\text{WSe}_2$ and phonon-assisted luminescence in cubic AgBr.
summary:
1. 作者开发LetzElPhC工作流，通过一致的对称性展开，在保留晶体对称性时解决全布里渊区激子—声子耦合计算的规范匹配问题。
2. 结合长程偶极、四极修正插值与多级并行，计算扩展至8192个CPU进程，并在能量对齐后重现单层WSe₂拉曼和AgBr声子辅助发光的主要谱学特征。
3. AgBr低温发光中LO、TA边带因宇称禁戒而缺失，表明该规范一致的对称性约化流程保留了决定激子—声子光谱的选择定则。

title: Diffusion Effects on a Stochastic Amplifier Driven by the Square of a Gaussian Field: Discontinuous Transition to Intermittency
abstract: We study the effects of diffusion on the transition to intermittency in stochastic amplification driven by the square of a Gaussian field. The transition is characterized by an order parameter quantifying the spatial uniformity of the amplification. We consider a model in which the diffusion-amplification process is embedded in a random lattice of point absorbers in such a way that the Feynman-Kac formula is restricted to Brownian paths with a range not exceeding a finite cut-off. In this setting, with the Gaussian driving field in a wide class of physical interest, we show that diffusion-induced damping of the amplification is sufficiently strong to change the nature of the transition: from continuous in the absence of diffusion, to discontinuous in the presence of diffusion.
summary:
1. 针对高斯场平方驱动放大的有限时间间歇性，作者在吸收点间距有界的随机格点模型中，证明一类相关场下的扩散使无扩散时的连续转变变为不连续转变。

title: High-Throughput Orientation Extraction via Symmetry-Adapted Filters
abstract: An algorithm for finding the orientation of objects in an image that have a known rotational symmetry, the symmetry-adapted filter (SAF) algorithm, is presented. It is deterministic and training-free, which makes it fast and reproducible. A filter that encodes the known rotational symmetry and approximate peak width is centered on the symmetry center of the object of interest, masked to the region of interest, and rotated to maximize its inner product with the image. The approach is demonstrated on more than 20,000 small-angle neutron scattering images of a torque-driven skyrmion lattice. It is also demonstrated on atomically resolved real-space images, where mapping local atomic orientations enabled the identification of grains and grain boundaries and the quantification of lattice relaxation.
summary:
1. 针对含噪图像中的晶格取向提取，作者构建编码已知旋转对称性的免训练滤波器，通过最大化旋转滤波器与图像的内积确定取向。
2. 该方法从两万余幅小角中子散射图中提取共存晶畴的取向，揭示热驱动斯格明子晶格随磁场降低由黏滑转为连续旋转。
3. 该方法还在实验电镜图像中识别晶粒、在模拟图像中提取晶界附近的取向弛豫长度，为实空间结构与倒空间动力学的定量取向表征提供统一途径。

title: EGQCA Code: automated high-throughput thermodynamic modeling of solid solutions
abstract: Modeling disordered systems from first principles across the full composition range is a long-standing computational challenge. We present a code package implementing the extended generalized quasichemical approximation (EGQCA), which describes solid solutions through the statistics of a finite set of clusters and enables their thermodynamic modeling at arbitrary compositions and temperatures. The package automates the complete workflow and interfaces with both DFT codes and universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs). We show that replacing DFT with uMLIPs reduces the cost of the cluster calculations by up to five orders of magnitude while preserving the thermodynamic predictions. To make computationally demanding properties tractable, we additionally introduce a cluster-selection algorithm that identifies the most relevant configurations. Together, these developments establish EGQCA as a fast and accurate framework for the thermodynamic modeling of solid solutions and a practical route toward high-throughput screening of disordered materials.
summary:
1. 作者将扩展广义准化学近似与机器学习原子间势结合，实现二元及准二元固溶体全成分范围的热力学自动建模，并按平衡团簇权重筛选重要构型。

3. 这些结果为高通量预测给定晶相内的相分离，以及降低全成分范围内昂贵物性评估的成本提供了计算路径。

title: Frozen Phonons on Dense $\mathbf{q}$-Grids Using Set Covers
abstract: Phonon dynamics determine a vast number of properties in the solid state, such as the heat capacity, thermal expansion, and thermal conductivity. Phonons are obtained through the dynamical matrix, which, in the frozen phonon approach, is calculated as a finite difference derivative of the analytical Hellmann-Feynman force. This approach unfortunately typically suffers from requiring very large supercells, even for modest $\mathbf{q}$-grids. The non-diagonal supercell method remedies this issue by determining the smallest supercell commensurate with a given $\mathbf{q}$-point, drastically reducing the supercell size, but in turn requiring a new supercell for each $\mathbf{q}$-point on the grid. This introduces redundancy, however, since a single non-diagonal supercell may be commensurate with several $\mathbf{q}$-points. In this work I present a method to determine a minimal set of supercells, such that every $\mathbf{q}$-point on the grid is commensurate with at least one supercell. I present an algorithm to solve the problem and prove that it yields the optimal solution, before summarizing the algorithm using pseudocode. The scaling of the number of supercells with the density of the grid is discussed. Numerical results on a variety of systems show the significant computational advantage of the method, which increases with the density of the grid.
summary:
1. 针对致密均匀波矢网格上冻结声子计算的超胞冗余，作者提出集合覆盖算法，并证明其给出的非对角超胞数最少。
2. 三维超胞数随网格边长呈近二次拟合标度，铝和氟化钙在16×16×16网格上的计算较逐点非对角超胞法约加速五倍。
3. 该优化不依赖晶体对称性，作者提出结合对称性进一步减少计算，并将方法拓展至电子—声子耦合与高阶力常数计算。

title: Transverse Shifts Driven by Geometric Orbital Torque in Altermagnets
abstract: Anomalous transverse shifts in interface reflection are conventionally attributed to spin-orbit coupling or its pseudospin analogue. Here, we uncover a distinct geometric mechanism driven solely by an orbital torque arising from Fermi-surface anisotropy. During total reflection, an incident wave packet penetrates the anisotropic transmitted medium as an evanescent wave. There, the broken rotational symmetry about the interface normal exerts an orbital torque, and the accumulated angular impulse---the product of the torque and the dwell time---leads to a transverse spatial shift. Applying this mechanism to altermagnets without spin-orbit coupling, we show that the orbital torque is odd in spin. As a consequence, the two spin channels are deflected to opposite sides of the incident plane, giving an intrinsic spatial spin separation in altermagnets. The shift also inherits the angular symmetry of the altermagnetic spin splitting and is strongly enhanced near the onset of total reflection. Our work thus uncovers a new mechanism for transverse shifts, predicts a novel spin separation effect in altermagnets, and offers a direct probe of the altermagnetic order.

1. 作者在无自旋轨道耦合的普通金属—交错磁体结中解析揭示，全反射时倏逝波在费米面各向异性产生的轨道力矩下积累角冲量，从而产生横向位移。

title: Emergent Chern metal in strongly correlated moiré bilayers
abstract: We investigate the topological properties of a strongly correlated moiré transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) bilayer (such as twisted $\mathrm{MoTe}_2$ or $\mathrm{WSe}_2$) hosting a spin-charge separated state coupled to a layer-polarized helical spin texture. Analyzing an effective low-energy Hamiltonian for mobile spinless holons moving through this non-coplanar spinon background, we reveal pronounced asymmetric band warping. This warping closes the global indirect band gap across most of the parameter space, restricting true topological insulators to fine-tuned critical trajectories. However, a finite local direct gap persists, stabilizing broad regions of a topological Chern metal ($C = \pm 1$). Computing the Chern number and density of states, we demonstrate that this phase naturally yields a sizable, non-quantized anomalous Hall response accompanied by finite longitudinal conduction, providing a purely electronic strong-coupling mechanism for dissipative anomalous Hall states in moiré systems.
summary:
1. 针对强关联莫尔TMD双层的拓扑金属起源，作者在自旋电荷分离及静态层极化反铁磁螺旋背景下，建立无自旋空穴子的有效模型。
2. 计算显示，能带翘曲下间接带隙闭合且直接带隙保留，在宽参数区形成能带陈数C=±1的金属，手性边缘模与有限费米能态密度共存。

title: Monotonic probes of asymmetry and robustness of the quantum Mpemba effect
abstract: Entanglement asymmetry has emerged as a powerful probe of symmetry restoration and the quantum Mpemba effect. However, its conventional Rényi generalizations, defined as differences of Rényi entropies, are not monotones in the resource-theoretic sense. Here, we investigate an alternative family of asymmetry quantifiers based on sandwiched Rényi divergences, which satisfy monotonicity under symmetry-preserving quantum channels. Developing a two-parameter replica approach, we show how these quantities can be computed from charged moments and establish a remarkable correspondence with conventional Rényi asymmetries under the inversion of the Rényi index, $\alpha\leftrightarrow 1/\alpha$. This relation, exact for pure states, holds at leading order in the relevant scaling limits for homogeneous quantum quenches, including interacting integrable systems, and for Haar-random states. Applying these results to quenches from tilted ferromagnetic states, we demonstrate that the quantum Mpemba effect is remarkably robust, occurring throughout the entire family of sandwiched Rényi asymmetry monotones. We identify dynamical regimes in quenches from spatially inhomogeneous initial states where conventional Rényi asymmetries and genuine monotones exhibit qualitatively different behaviours. We also investigate a solvable toy model illustrating the possible dependence of Mpemba crossings on the Rényi index. Our findings establish a connection between conventional Rényi asymmetries and quantum resource theory, explaining their effectiveness in broad classes of nonequilibrium protocols while highlighting the additional information provided by genuine asymmetry monotones.
summary:
1. 针对量子姆潘巴效应对非对称性量度的依赖，作者发展双参数复本法，以带电矩计算夹心Rényi散度单调量。
2. 该量与传统Rényi熵差的倒数阶对应对纯态精确成立，在均匀可积淬火和Haar随机态的相应标度极限领先阶成立，且倾斜铁磁态自由费米子淬火的姆潘巴效应覆盖所有有限α≥1/2。
3. 非均匀淬火中熵差的暂态增长与单调量的初值上界，揭示了谱及荷扇区重排与非对称性资源变化的区别。

title: Brightening spin- and parity-forbidden interlayer excitons through rhombohedral stacking
abstract: Brightened symmetry-forbidden excitons can provide critical information about the electronic structure and many-body interactions in semiconductors. Recently, interlayer atomic registry has emerged as a new way to control atomically thin layered materials in both ground and excited states. Here we show that the rhombohedral stacking in a 3R-MoS_2 homobilayer can brighten two symmetry-forbidden interlayer excitons: one is a spin-unlike 1s exciton and the other is a parity-odd 2p exciton. The nature of these interlayer excitons is revealed by their gfactors as well as the hybridization patterns observed when they are tuned to resonate with intralayer excitons. Surprisingly, the hybridized 2p exciton exhibits a constructive quantum interference between the acquired transition dipoles, revealing a hidden gauge-invariant phase contrast between the constituent electronic states. Our results establish stacking control as a powerful approach for modulating quantum phases of excitons in 2D semiconductors.
summary:
1. 作者在3R-MoS₂同质双层中，结合电场调谐光谱与第一性原理计算，点亮并鉴定了自旋禁阻1s和宇称禁阻2p层间激子。
2. 1s态仅与一层的层内激子显著杂化，2p态与两层激子近等幅反号耦合，所获跃迁偶极相长干涉，使其振子强度达到层内激子量级。
3. 这种干涉揭示了组成激子的布洛赫态间规范不变的相位差，确立了通过堆垛调控激子量子相位的途径。

title: Magnons in solids with correlated atomic and nanoscale disorder
abstract: Atomic defects and disorder affect both the microscopic magnon excitations and the macroscopic physical properties of real-world magnetic materials. The rationalization of this relation has hitherto remained elusive, because of the intertwined challenges of simulating with quantum accuracy atomic- and nanoscale inhomogeneities and correlations, and their effect on the magnon spectral function determining observables such as spin stiffness. Here, we introduce a theoretical and computational framework to address these challenges. First, we develop the Coupled Optimization of SpIN Environment (COSINE) algorithm for efficiently relaxing the atomic structure and magnetic configuration of a solid with defects or disorder to a local energy minimum. Then, we discuss how to efficiently obtain exchange interactions accounting for local compositional, structural, and magnetic-moment inhomogeneities. Finally, we develop a paraunitary unfolding approach for Bogoliubov bosons, which allows us to predict the magnon spectral function in materials with any magnetic order, including systems with canting and full, partial, or no magnetic-moment compensation. We showcase our approach in a representative defective ferrimagnet for generality, and then combine it with state-of-the-art spin-informed machine-learning potentials to quantitatively predict how nonuniformities in the spatial distribution of vacancy defects control blurring of effective magnon bandstructures.

2. 铁的模拟显示，同为3.2%空位浓度时，1/r空间关联使所考察高能模线宽缩至无关联情形的约1/2至1/3，最强团簇样品的拟合自旋刚度最低。
3. 该框架适用于非共线磁序，为通过缺陷空间排布调控磁振子谱与自旋刚度提供了定量途径。

title: Quantum critical collapse to an extremal black hole
abstract: It has been emphasized recently that some extremal black holes are "critical" solutions, lying at the threshold between gravitational collapse and dispersion. We study the effect of quantum gravity on critical solutions for the collapse of a thin shell of charged dust. We consider the Hamiltonian that generates the shell equation of motion with respect to the exterior Killing time and coincides with the ADM energy on-shell. Near criticality, this Hamiltonian is shown to be canonically equivalent to that of a Liouville theory with negative potential. After quantization, this model predicts that a collapsing shell has a non-trivial probability of undergoing a quantum mechanical bounce when its energy above extremality is comparable to the "breakdown scale". The bounce probability approaches unity at extremality. Hence this model predicts that the critical surface in the classical theory is thickened quantum mechanically into a "critical layer". The probability density function for the black hole energy is suppressed below the breakdown scale in the same way as found recently by Turiaci and Wu.
summary:
1. 针对极端黑洞形成阈值的量子修正，作者将静质量略低于电荷的球对称带电尘埃薄壳近临界动力学化为负势刘维尔模型，并作开放系统量子化。
2. 模型给出E>Q时定能壳层的反弹概率P=exp[−√((E−Q)/E★)]，该概率在E→Q⁺时趋于1，其中E★=ℏ²/(32π²Q³)（G=1）。
3. 量子反弹将经典临界面展宽为能宽约E★的临界层，所得黑洞能量概率密度在近极端处具有√(E−Q)抑制因子，与JT引力模型的结果一致。

title: The black hole IR triangle for scalar QED
abstract: We construct the black hole infrared triangle of scalar QED on a stretched Schwarzschild horizon at tree level. In the covariant phase space of the near-horizon Maxwell field, the soft charge is a corner term. The memory is the zero mode of the gauge-invariant radiative field along the generators. It is conjugate to the boundary gauge mode that labels the degenerate horizon vacua, and Gauss' law fixes it by the flux of charge through the horizon. The Noether flux of the residual gauge transformation through the stretched horizon is not conserved by the scattering, because charged matter crosses the stretched horizon in both directions. The flux with its matter part removed is the soft charge, which generates the large gauge transformation. Its Ward identity is equivalent to a soft photon theorem in every radiative partial wave, which we derive from the near-horizon Feynman rules and, where these do not control the emission, from the field equations at leading order. The main difference from null infinity is that on a stretched horizon both radial branches of the field are independent boundary data. The hard charge is a radial flux. With both branches present it weights each leg by the direction of its radial motion, and the soft factor is a sign per leg. The endpoint data on the two branches give two boundary observables, the time-integrated transverse magnetic and electric fields. The field radiated by a scattering process contributes only to the first, where it cancels the change in the Coulomb memory of the charges, so that the soft charge is conserved. A charge that crosses the horizon enters both. We also discuss the infrared divergence, the dressing of the external states, and the fate of the memory in the Hartle--Hawking state, where it performs a random walk driven by the Hawking radiation.
summary:
1. 作者在史瓦西黑洞的拉伸视界上，于树级建立标量量子电动力学中大规范对称性、软光子定理与记忆效应的红外三角关系。
2. 软荷的沃德恒等式等价于每个辐射分波的软光子定理，两支独立径向边界数据使软因子成为按各外腿径向运动方向确定的符号。
3. 记忆与标记简并视界真空的边界规范模共轭，并由穿越视界的电荷通量确定；散射辐射抵消库仑记忆的变化，确保软荷守恒。

title: The OPE of lines beyond CFT
abstract: We discuss the fusion of parallel line defects in theories defined by relevant deformations of a conformal fixed point. We propose an operator product expansion to describe this limit in terms of a Wilsonian effective action whose coefficients are computable in conformal perturbation theory around the UV. This allows one to fix, order by order, the fusion limit of correlation functions involving the defects, up to non-perturbative coefficients associated to correlation functions (condensates) on the fused defect. It thus generalizes the familiar OPE of local operators in QFT. As a non-perturbative test of our proposal, we consider the short-distance potential between two magnetic impurities in the $2d$ Ising model. We find excellent agreement between the OPE framework and DMRG extractions of the potential and condensates (the latter also computed exactly with integrability). In addition, we consider a number of solvable models to illustrate different features of the framework.
summary:
1. 针对共形固定点经相关变形所得理论中的平行线缺陷融合，作者提出威尔逊有效作用量形式的算符乘积展开，其系数可由紫外共形微扰论逐阶计算。
2. 在二维伊辛模型中，两磁性杂质间的短程势及缺陷凝聚量与DMRG提取结果高度吻合，凝聚量还通过可积性精确求得。
3. 该框架将局域算符的乘积展开推广至线缺陷，给定融合缺陷上的非微扰凝聚量后，即可逐阶确定含缺陷关联函数的融合极限。

title: The String Theory Photinoverse
abstract: Type-IIB string compactifications typically give rise to a significant number of RR-photons. These are generically massless and do not possess any light charged states, making them `superhidden'. However, since supersymmetry is present at least at some high scale, corresponding `dark photinos' are also predicted. The kinetic mixing of the photons together with the SUSY breaking mass terms of the photinos makes the latter observable. We identify geometries in which the mixing is induced by Wilson lines and show that their expectation values are generically non-zero. As a result, most of the dark photinos, which are lighter than the visible sector SUSY breaking scale, mix significantly with the bino and hence couple to the Standard Model sufficiently strongly to leave potentially observable traces. In particular, volume modulus and inflaton decays generically induce a cosmological abundance of dark photinos that can explain dark matter. We find that the `natural Photinoverse dark matter parameter space' is already accessible to current experiments, notably gamma ray observations, which therefore have discovery potential in the near future.
summary:
1. 作者在IIB型弦紧致化中构造含共享三维同调圈的几何，证明Wilson线通常稳定于非零值，并通过动力学混合与超对称破缺建立暗光微子与可见扇区的耦合。
2. 在复结构F项由次领先修正诱导的大体积方案中，多数暗光微子的质量按Mₚ/𝒱²缩放，与bino的混合按𝒱⁻¹抑制。
3. 在R宇称守恒、体积模衰变主导再加热时，暗光微子可构成全部暗物质，相应跃迁伽马信号的估计量级已进入现有实验探测范围，为检验这类紧致化模型提供途径。

title: Gauge groups of type 0 orientifolds
abstract: We determine the global form of the gauge groups of the orthogonal and symplectic type 0 orientifolds, using the constraints from perturbative and brane states. In the process, we correct some misprints in type 0 vacuum amplitudes that have propagated in the literature. For type 0A, our analysis reveals a parity condition on the numbers of D9-branes in the orthogonal orientifold and a puzzle concerning the decay of a tachyonic D0-brane in the symplectic orientifold.
summary:
1. 作者利用微扰态与膜态的约束，确定了正交型和辛型0型定向投影弦理论中规范群的全局形式。
2. 分析揭示了0A型正交定向投影中D9膜数目的奇偶性条件，并纠正了文献中沿用的0型真空振幅误植。
3. 研究还识别出0A型辛定向投影中快子性D0膜衰变的疑难，揭示了该模型不稳定膜态衰变中尚待解释的具体问题。

title: Unitarization from Spin Geometry
abstract: We derive the dimensional reduction of 10D super Yang-Mills theory on a general closed 6D spin manifold using spectral decompositions for the higher-dimensional gauge field and gaugino, keeping the infinite towers of Kaluza-Klein (KK) modes in the lower-dimensional theory. We then calculate tree-level $2 \rightarrow 2$ scattering amplitudes with external massive spinors and vectors in this lower-dimensional theory. By studying the high-energy behavior of these amplitudes and imposing perturbative unitarity, we derive several sum rules that involve the eigenvalues of Laplace and Dirac operators on the internal 6-manifold, together with products of cubic coupling constants of the KK modes. These give concrete realizations of the known unitarity sum rules for spontaneously broken gauge theories. We illustrate explicitly how the simplest sum rule is satisfied for flat tori and round spheres.
summary:
1. 为揭示含费米子KK散射的高能幺正化机制，作者在一般六维闭自旋流形上约化十维超杨–米尔斯理论，并保留完整模态塔。
2. 作者导出并以谱完备性和结合律证明四条联系拉普拉斯、狄拉克谱与三次耦合的求和规则，消去树级二体散射振幅的E²和E增长，得到固定角高能O(1)行为。
3. 这些一致性条件进一步表明，若某一重矢量耦合两个质量不同的费米子，则必存在经该矢量相连、质量逐级递增的无限费米子链。

title: Neural Network Field Theory and the AdS/CFT Correspondence
abstract: We develop a neural realization of massive scalar field theory on Euclidean anti--de Sitter space and its holographic boundary observables within neural network field theory (NN--FT). We construct Fourier--Bessel cosine neurons whose covariance reproduces the regulated massive AdS propagator exactly at finite network width, with the Gaussian field theory recovered in the infinite-width limit. We introduce quartic interactions through two complementary approaches. The first implements a prescribed interaction by deforming the neural parameter measure, while the second generates a local quartic interaction from the statistics of auxiliary binary neurons. Applying the BDHM prescription directly to the neural ensemble, we recover the scalar bulk-to-boundary propagator, the conformal boundary two-point function, and the leading connected four-point contact Witten diagram. We further show that distinct neural architectures can reproduce the same leading boundary correlators while defining inequivalent bulk theories. These results establish a framework for studying interacting scalar holography within NN--FT and clarify the role of neural architecture in encoding bulk dynamics and boundary observables.
summary:
1. 作者以傅里叶–贝塞尔神经元构造固定欧氏AdS上的正则化有质量标量场，并通过测度变形或二元辅助神经元的群体极限引入局域正四次相互作用。
2. 自由协方差在有限宽度精确匹配传播子，无限宽度恢复高斯场，BDHM极限重现分离点共形二点函数及4Δ>d时的一阶四点接触Witten图。
3. 独立余弦架构在体传播子中引入更高质量成分并保留上述边界关联，表明这些低阶边界数据对应的体理论并不唯一。

title: Energy plateau cascades from complex-time local quenches in thermal two-dimensional CFTs
abstract: In this work, we study local operator quenches in thermal two-dimensional conformal field theories with complex-time evolution, which can be viewed as an effective description of conditional dynamics in a system interacting with an environment. In contrast to quenches of the vacuum, the thermal initial state allows several conformal families to participate in the evolution. We show that their competition can produce cascades of approximately homogeneous energy plateaux, with successive plateaux approaching the energies of different primary states. Using conformal Ward identities on the cylinder and torus, we determine the local energy density and illustrate this behavior in free-field theories, the Ising model and Wess--Zumino--Witten models. We develop a cold-limit spectral description in which the dominant primary channel determines the height of each plateau, while conformal dimensions and operator matrix elements govern the transitions between them. For a fixed compact unitary CFT, we show that only finitely many primary channels can contribute to the leading plateau sequence. Finally, we discuss the large-central-charge regime, relating light-operator plateaux to few-particle sectors in thermal AdS and examining the limitations of this picture for heavy quenches.
summary:
1. 作者利用沃德恒等式和低温谱分解，揭示圆周上热态二维共形场论的复时间局域淬火中，欧氏过滤通过初级态通道竞争产生近均匀能量平台级联的机制。
2. 在低温长过滤极限下，固定紧致幺正理论的领先平台序列仅涉及满足Δ_a+Δ_d≤Δ_O的有限初级态对，电荷N/R的紧致玻色子顶角淬火产生N个非真空平台。
3. 平台高度由主导输出态的共形权确定，交叉位置及有限温偏移分别编码共形维数与算符矩阵元，为通过局域能量探测共形谱和算符耦合提供途径。

title: Bounds on Love Numbers and Quasinormal Modes from the Surface Impedance
abstract: The surface impedance of a body is fixed by its interior alone and encodes its entire tidal response. We derive bounds on Love numbers and quasinormal modes from constraints on the impedance that follow from either of two properties of a stable body: it is lossless, meaning that it dissipates no energy, or it is passive, meaning that it never gives back more energy than it has received. For a lossless body, every dynamical Love number is bounded from above and below, exactly in general relativity, in any renormalization scheme and at any scale. Earlier bounds are exact for Newtonian stars but fail for compact stars, because they take the response to arbitrarily fast tides to be zero or non-negative, whereas in general relativity it is negative. The quasinormal modes of a lossless body are also excluded from a region of the complex frequency plane set by the mass and radius. Each known Love number enlarges the excluded region. Conversely, the quasinormal modes bound each Love number from below, given the lower ones. For a passive body of horizon scale, such as a black hole, the static Love number lies in a window that closes onto the vanishing black-hole value as the body's surface approaches the horizon.
summary:
1. 作者通过表面阻抗分离非旋转稳定天体的内部响应与外部传播，从无耗散性或无源性推导勒夫数及准正规模的物理界限。
2. 无耗散天体各阶动力学勒夫数的上下界在广义相对论中对任意重整化方案与尺度精确成立，已知勒夫数可扩大准正规模禁区，模频则反向约束勒夫数。
3. 采用不含表面能项的扰动能定义无源性时，无源天体的静态勒夫数窗口随表面逼近视界收敛于黑洞零值，从而限制近视界天体的静态潮汐响应。

title: Chaotic singularities inside vacuum black holes
abstract: According to the conjecture of Belinski, Khalatnikov and Lifshitz, general relativity gives rise to chaotic dynamics in the vicinity of generic spacelike singularities. However, no vacuum black hole has been shown to exhibit this behaviour. Here we construct stationary, asymptotically locally AdS$_5$ black holes with regular, triaxially squashed horizons and causal exteriors, whose homogeneous interiors realize the cosmological billiard of generic five-dimensional vacuum gravity. We identify a simple algebraic condition on the horizon data that is necessary for the interior billiard to be chaotic, and show that solutions with regular horizons locally access an open set of billiard trajectories.
summary:
1. 针对真空黑洞能否容纳BKL混沌的问题，作者数值构造了视界正则且三轴压扁、外部满足因果性的五维定常渐近局域AdS真空黑洞。
2. 其均匀内部实现一般五维真空引力的有限体积AE₄宇宙学台球，数值分辨出的52次孤立Kasner跃迁符合壁面反射规律。
3. 固定视界面积下的五维响应矩阵数值满秩，表明正则黑洞局部可达台球轨迹的开集，说明正则视界与一般混沌演化相容。

title: RMT${}_2$: Random Spectral Correlations for CFT${}_2$ and AdS${}_3$ Gravity
abstract: We present the full framework of RMT${}_2$, a consistent unification of random matrix theory and modular invariance. The systematic prescription, which augments the existing construction by incorporating spin, lifts random matrix correlators to $\text{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$ Poincaré sums of their Mellin transforms, in a manner which enforces random matrix correlations near extremality in every spinning primary sector. The resulting RMT${}_2$ correlators are further expressible in terms of an orthogonal basis of Eisenstein series and Maass cusp forms. We demonstrate the construction by lifting the two-point correlators at arbitrary genus of the Airy model, in both unitary and orthogonal symmetry classes, exhibiting the modular-invariant topological expansion of RMT${}_2$; a resummation of the genus expansion shows that the modular-invariant spectral form factor preserves the ramp-plateau structure. Holographically, RMT${}_2$ provides a concrete benchmark and explicit candidate expressions for comparison with off-shell wormhole amplitudes in AdS${}_3$ gravity, with any number of torus boundaries. We explicitly compute the universal RMT${}_2$ three-point correlator, corresponding to the putative three-boundary wormhole.
summary:
1. 作者通过梅林变换与庞加莱求和，为二维共形场论构造任意阶模不变连通谱关联，在每个固定自旋扇区的近极端极限恢复给定的随机矩阵统计。
2. Airy模型酉类和正交类的两点函数具有任意亏格的拓扑展开，重求和显示谱形状因子在τ标度极限保留斜坡—平台结构。
3. 零亏格普适三点函数给出AdS₃三环面边界虫洞的显式候选振幅，为比较引力计算与模不变谱统计提供基准。

title: Machine Learning for Calabi--Yau Geometry and Heterotic Compactification
abstract: Quantitative predictions from string compactification depend on geometric data that are difficult to compute analytically. This review surveys machine learning approaches to predicting topological properties of Calabi-Yau manifolds, discusses the search for new Calabi-Yau fourfolds, as well as numerical methods for approximating Ricci-flat metrics. In the context of heterotic compactifications, we explain how bundle metrics and harmonic matter forms enter calculations of canonically normalized Yukawa couplings and axion-matter interactions. We also outline applications to flux compactifications, warped and corrected backgrounds, and geometric structures beyond the Calabi-Yau setting. Finally, we review available datasets and software, highlight connections with analytic methods, and discuss geometric constraints, numerical validation, and recent progress in rigorous error control.
summary:
1. 针对弦紧致化所需几何数据难以解析计算的问题，本文综述机器学习预测卡拉比–丘流形拓扑、搜寻新四复维实例及数值逼近里奇平坦度量的方法。
2. 在杂化弦紧致化中，文章阐明向量丛度量与物质场调和形式如何进入正则归一化汤川耦合及轴子—物质相互作用的计算，连接几何数据与物理预测。
3. 综述还概述通量紧致化、翘曲和修正背景及非卡拉比–丘几何中的应用，并讨论几何约束、数值验证及严格误差控制的进展。

title: On the Structure Constants of ${\cal N}=2$ Liouville Theory
abstract: We show the structure constants of $\mathcal{N}=2$ spacelike Liouville theory. The absence of self-duality under $b\leftrightarrow b^{-1}$, where $b$ is the Liouville coupling, prevents a straightforward application of the standard bootstrap methods used in $\mathcal{N}=0$ and $\mathcal{N}=1$ Liouville theory. Motivated by the fermionic FZZ duality with the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})/U(1)$ supercoset theory, we establish an algebraic correspondence between the two theories, including a matching of their null vectors. We then derive the three-point structure constants in superspace.
